name: K3 Nova
description_en:
K3Nova describes itself as an independent Kimi-style AI workspace for chat, research, code and document tasks. Its own FAQ says it uses its own interface and implementation; it is not an official Kimi account or a subscription to Moonshot’s service.

The workspace brings files and conversation context into a task and offers several output modes. Model availability, task execution and exported artifact quality need a live check; visible model labels or a “checking service” message do not establish that inference is working.
description_zh:
K3Nova 自称独立的 Kimi 风格 AI 工作区，覆盖聊天、研究、代码和文档任务。其 FAQ 说明使用自身界面及实现，不是官方 Kimi 账户，也不是 Moonshot 服务订阅。

工作区将文件及会话上下文带入任务，并提供多种输出模式。模型可用性、任务执行及导出产物质量需要实际核对，显示模型标签或“检查服务中”不能证明推理已正常运行。

sections.title_en: Evaluate one constrained task and its handoff
sections.title_zh: 评估一个有约束的任务及交付
sections.en:
The homepage describes keeping files, notes, code snippets and follow-up prompts together, then selecting a memo, code review, slides or website-oriented output. Its suggested first test includes a real constraint, a target format and a follow-up. These are the vendor’s workflow descriptions, not a benchmark of model reasoning or document generation.

A hypothetical evaluation could attach a small public specification, request a table of unresolved requirements and ask a follow-up about one cited line. Verify that the output preserves names, dates and the original constraint, and open any exported artifact in its intended application. This research did not submit a prompt or download an artifact.
sections.zh:
首页说明将文件、笔记、代码片段及后续提示保留在一起，再选择备忘录、代码审查、幻灯片或网站方向输出；建议首测包含真实约束、目标格式及追问。这些是厂商流程说明，不是模型推理或文档生成基准测试。

假设评估可附小型公开规格，要求列未解决需求表，再追问其中引用行。核对输出是否保留名称、日期及原约束，并在目标应用打开导出产物。本文未提交提示或下载产物。

sections.title_en: A local workspace is not local model weights
sections.title_zh: 本地工作区不等于本地模型权重
sections.en:
The local-agent guide distinguishes a locally running client or workspace from inference through a hosted endpoint. It says the K3Nova workspace can run locally for development with a server-side model backend and protected credentials. Its examples also discuss other agents and model names; those external products and their current model identifiers were not verified here.

Before self-hosting, verify the linked source, license, supported backend and authentication setup. A guide’s claim of local operation does not establish a private offline model, zero external data transfer or official provider affiliation. Do not send sensitive project material until the actual processing and retention path is understood.
sections.zh:
本地 Agent 指南区分本地运行的客户端／工作区与通过托管端点进行推理，说明 K3Nova 可本地用于开发，并使用服务器端模型后端及受保护凭据。指南还讨论其他 Agent 和模型名，这些外部产品及当前模型标识本文未核。

自托管前应核对链接源码、许可、受支持后端及认证设置。指南所称本地运行不能证明是私有离线模型、完全无外部数据传输或官方提供商关联。实际处理及保留路径明确前，不应发送敏感项目材料。

sections.title_en: Agent and code allowances are separate
sections.en:
The pricing page displays Moderato at USD111.72/year, Allegretto229.32, Allegro582.12 and Vivace1170.12; corresponding monthly-billing labels are13.30,27.30,69.30 and139.30. Annual membership gives the same monthly allowance at a lower effective rate. Allowances reset each billing cycle, and approximate Agent credits vary with task token use.

The page explicitly separates shared Agent/member allowances from k3nova Code allowance. Concurrency and Swarm subtask limits also vary by plan. Do not equate one credit with one completed task or treat a K3Nova subscription as an external Kimi account. Checkout, code-credit units, actual backend access and refund terms were not tested.
sections.zh:
价格页显示 Moderato 年111.72美元、Allegretto229.32、Allegro582.12、Vivace1170.12；对应月付标签为13.30、27.30、69.30、139.30。年付以较低月均提供同样月度额度，额度每账期重置，近似Agent额度随任务token用量变化。

页面明确区分共享Agent／会员额度与k3nova Code独立额度，任务并发及Swarm子任务限额也随套餐不同。不能将一个credit等同一个完成任务，也不能把K3Nova订阅当作外部Kimi账户。本文未测试结账、代码额度单位、实际后端访问或退款条款。
